articles.title: Belgium's Tactical Brilliance Overwhelms USA in Seattle Showdown
articles.excerpt: Belgium defeats USA 4-1 in front of a packed Lumen Field, securing their spot in the World Cup quarter-finals.
articles.image_caption: Lumen Field in Seattle, WA — venue for USA vs Belgium at the 2026 FIFA World Cup (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: Seattle's large Indian-American community added a vibrant cultural dimension to the World Cup match atmosphere.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Spain Edges Portugal as Mikel Merino's Late Strike Sends Iberian Rivals Packing
articles.excerpt: Mikel Merino's stoppage-time goal propels Spain past Portugal in a tense Round of 16 clash.
articles.image_caption: AT&T Stadium in Arlington, TX — venue for Portugal vs Spain at the 2026 FIFA World Cup (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: The Indian-American community in the Dallas-Fort Worth area, one of the largest in the U.S., embraced the World Cup with enthusiasm, adding a vibrant cultural layer to the match atmosphere.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: World Cup Day 26: Belgium beat USA 4-1; Spain beat Portugal 1-0
articles.excerpt: Group stage action from Seattle, WA, Arlington, TX on July 06 — 2 matches, no shortage of drama.
articles.nri_angle: World Cup matches in US cities near major NRI communities. 0 of today's 2 matches were in cities with large Indian-American populations.

articles.title: Haaland Scores Twice. Neymar Says Goodbye. Norway End Brazil's World Cup Dream at MetLife.
articles.excerpt: The Manchester City striker headed in the opener and fired an unstoppable second as Norway reached the quarterfinals for the first time. Brazil haven't made the last eight since 1990.
articles.image_caption: Erling Haaland celebrates after scoring his seventh World Cup goal against Brazil at MetLife Stadium
articles.nri_angle: NRI fans packed MetLife Stadium in New Jersey's Indian diaspora heartland to witness one of the biggest World Cup upsets in history.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Trail 1-0. Bishnoi's 29-Run Over Still Stings. Trent Bridge on Tuesday Is Do-or-Die.
articles.excerpt: England's shortest boundaries, India's youngest debutant, and a series that threatens to slip away before it's even half done. Here's everything at stake in the 3rd T20I.
articles.image_caption: Trent Bridge cricket ground in Nottingham, venue for the crucial 3rd T20I between England and India
articles.nri_angle: With the series slipping away, NRI cricket fans in the UK face a crucial midweek fixture while US-based fans can catch the action on Willow TV at lunchtime.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bethell's Unbeaten 76 Sinks India at Old Trafford. Bishnoi's 29-Run Over Hands England a 1-0 Series Lead.
articles.excerpt: Arshdeep took two wickets in the first over. Bethell took the match in the 17th. India trail in the five-match T20I series after a four-wicket loss in Manchester.
articles.image_caption: Emirates Old Trafford Cricket Ground in Manchester, venue for the second T20I between England and India
articles.nri_angle: Tens of thousands of NRI fans packed Old Trafford, and millions more watched from the US, Canada, and UK — the T20I series offers the best live cricket viewing opportunity of the British summer.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ounahi Scores Twice. Morocco End Canada's World Cup on the Fourth of July.
articles.excerpt: Canada were the better team for 45 minutes. Morocco were the better team for the match. A 3-0 loss in Houston ends the co-hosts' best-ever run.
articles.image_caption: Azzedine Ounahi of Morocco during the 2026 FIFA World Cup
articles.nri_angle: Nearly 1.8 million Canadians of Indian origin rallied behind the co-host side — the World Cup gave NRIs in Canada a source of unexpected civic pride, and the run inspired first-time football fans from Brampton to Surrey.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: He's 15 Years and 99 Days Old. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi Just Broke Sachin Tendulkar's 36-Year Record.
articles.excerpt: The Rajasthan Royals prodigy received his India cap at Old Trafford on Saturday, becoming the youngest male cricketer to represent the country — and ending a debate that began the moment he hit 72 sixes in IPL 2026.
articles.image_caption: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, India's youngest-ever international cricketer, photographed during a meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi
articles.nri_angle: A generational shift in Indian cricket that NRIs across the US, UK, and Canada are watching unfold — the 15-year-old prodigy who broke Sachin's 36-year record represents the IPL era's first truly global cricketing sensation.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Fireworks, Then Football. The World Cup Takes Over the Fourth of July — and NRIs Have the Best Seats in the House.
articles.excerpt: Canada face Morocco in Houston at 1 PM ET. France meet Paraguay in Philadelphia at 5 PM ET. For Indian Americans, a holiday spent watching the world's biggest tournament on American soil is an experience without precedent.
articles.image_caption: The FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 16 bracket, confirmed after the final Round of 32 matches on July 3
articles.nri_angle: For 4.5 million Indian Americans, the Fourth of July has a new main event — two World Cup knockout matches on American soil, in cities with massive South Asian communities.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
